terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A parked vehicle prop: an exterior shell with no interior geometry, since a prop kit is only ever looked at from outside and the glazing is authored as a tinted, mostly opaque pane. The wheels are the mechanisms: each is a named pivot on its axle. Nothing else moves and nothing attaches, so there are no sockets. The most common vehicle on Thai roads. The plate shows a navy underbone with white pinstripes on the leg shield and side covers, a black vinyl seat, chrome rear rack, round chrome mirrors on tall stems, a rectangular headlamp between amber indicators, silver engine cases, a chrome exhaust and wire-spoked wheels with drum hubs.

reasoning: The identity is the underbone layout: a leg shield rising to a headlamp cowl, a step-through floor, side covers under a flat seat, a chrome rack behind it, spoked wheels front and rear. It is an assembly of small parts, not one shell.
Two materials: the paint (leg shield, covers, fenders, cowl, pinstripes as vertex colours) and a white vertex-coloured trim carrying chrome, alloy, black, seat vinyl, lamp lenses and the tyres.
One repetition system: two wheels off one lathe, each a named pivot on its axle.
Action readiness is the wheels: two hinge pivots, convex collider, not breakable. Steering is not articulated.

specDepthDecision.rationale: A motorcycle is legible by its silhouette gaps as much as its masses -- the step-through, the daylight under the seat, the space inside the fork -- so the frame is tubes and the panels are thin extrusions rather than one blocked mass. Every tube run is a polyline of cylinders merged into one geometry.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

resolvedUnknowns: The wheels are wire-spoked in the plate; the spokes are eighteen thin boxes merged into the wheel lathe, and the hub dish behind them is a mid grey so the wheel does not read as a hole at prop distance.

The turntable gate's enclosed-background signal fires on the step-through gap and on the daylight inside the fork and under the seat: real open air on a motorcycle. --allow-holes is set on the _holecc measurement.
The right side is mirrored from the left; the exhaust runs on the right.
preSpecAssessment.unknownsResolutionNote: Emptied because every entry has been RESOLVED with a recorded authoring decision, not because the gaps went away. Each is restated in assumptions and in viewEvidence with its confidence and a null path. Nothing was invented to close a gap.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 0.70 x 1.07 x 1.92 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=4000 triangles, <=4 draw calls, <=3 materials, <=6 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus one named pivot per wheel (2); zero sockets; convex collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

specRefineTriggers: local feature not traceable to viewEvidence
codeRefineTriggers: spec is adequate but generated geometry/material does not match
lighting hides geometry or material response
stopCriteria: target fidelity reached or user accepts current approximation

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: single-image extraction is reference-derived inference, not exact photogrammetry

mustAvoid: plastic-looking smooth bark, stone, cloth, foliage, or aged material
local color/detail described only in prose without material masks
claiming exact PBR recovery when confidence is below the target threshold
reference lighting copied without separating material readability

screenshotReview: Compare albedo palette and local color zones.
Compare cavity dirt, edge wear, stains, moss, scratches, or other local masks.
Compare key/fill/rim structure, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadows.
Capture a neutral-light render to verify material readability without reference lighting.
Capture a grazing-light close-up to expose flat normals, uniform roughness, tiling, and plastic highlights.
Capture a reference-matched render from the same camera framing as the source.

pivotInventory.justification: A wheel turns on its axle; the pivot sits at the hub. Doors, bonnet and tailgate are part of the shell and get no axis: nothing in this kit opens them.

actionReadiness.socketJustification: ZERO sockets, deliberately. Nothing attaches to this vehicle in the kit and nothing is emitted from it; a marker named for a place on the surface is a location, not a mechanism.

colliderInventory.note: Declared on the asset as convex: one hull over the whole machine.

actionReadiness.destructionJustification: The asset declares destructionGroups as an empty list -- this prop is NOT breakable. No component carries actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup. promote-model checks built against declared as an equality in BOTH directions, so an invented group fails the gate just as a missing one would.

assumptions: The wheels are wire-spoked in the plate; the spokes are eighteen thin boxes merged into the wheel lathe, and the hub dish behind them is a mid grey so the wheel does not read as a hole at prop distance.

The turntable gate's enclosed-background signal fires on the step-through gap and on the daylight inside the fork and under the seat: real open air on a motorcycle. --allow-holes is set on the _holecc measurement.
The right side is mirrored from the left; the exhaust runs on the right.

coordinateFrame.notes: Origin base-center at tyre contact, +Y up, +Z FORWARD, +X the vehicle's left. Meshy returned the proxy with its long axis on X, an arbitrary output convention; the band comparison detects the mismatch from the two footprints and rotates the reference a quarter turn before measuring.

silhouette.description: Wheels 0.54 m in diameter at z +0.76 and -0.48 (1.24 wheelbase); a front fender arc over the front wheel; fork legs up to a headlamp cowl at 0.86-1.00 m; handlebar at 1.00 m with mirrors to 1.125 m; a leg shield from 0.32 to 0.84 m at z 0.36-0.62; a step-through floor at 0.33-0.39 m; side covers 0.40-0.60 m under a seat at 0.61-0.71 m from z 0.03 to -0.59; a rack at 0.60 m to z -1.00; engine block under the floor.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x spans -0.35..+0.35 at the handlebar and mirror tips; y 0.00 to 1.125 at the mirror heads; z -1.04..+1.03 rear rack to front fender, +Z forward. The Meshy proxy normalises to L:H:W = 1 : 0.654 : 0.384 (1.92 x 1.26 x 0.74 at the declared length); the registry height of 1.07 is to the bar tops and the mirrors add the rest, as they do here.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate normalises to L:H:W = 1 : 0.654 : 0.384. Its side elevation (scratch/honda-wave/_ev/side.png) reads wheels 0.30 H at 0.10 L and 0.87 L, seat 0.55-0.60 H over 0.45-0.65 L, leg shield 0.30-0.65 H at 0.22-0.32 L, bars 0.82 H, mirrors to 1.00 H, rack 0.55 H over 0.70-0.95 L -- and those fractions at the declared 1.92 m are what is built. The band table's residuals are the proxy's mirror-inclusive height.

viewEvidence.note: NOT DIRECTLY OBSERVED. Confidence 0.80: the plate shows the left side; the right is mirrored, with the exhaust on the right as the type has it.

roughness.notes: Scalar observed for this surface in the plate. The independently extracted map is kept on disk as evidence and is NOT bound at runtime -- this material is textureless, so the scalar is the runtime value.

albedo.samplingNotes: Measured as the mean of crops/paint.png. extract_pbr_evidence confidence 0.763. The extractor palette is advisory only: these crops are flat material swatches, not isolated objects, so its foreground separation is weak by its own warnings. Albedo is the direct crop measurement.

localOverrides.evidence: A faint dust wash to 0.25 of a 1.2 m height-keyed tile; the plate's panels are clean above the floor.

evidence: Measured on viewEvidence region-paint (side cover, PBR confidence 0.763) at #343f58, luma 63. Shipped as measured: the panels are thin and set against chrome and daylight, and the turntable gate did not read them as holes. White pinstripes #d8dde0 are vertex-coloured boxes 4 mm proud.
Textureless as DECLARED: a light road-dust multiplier canvas is bound after construction.
textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

The extractor palette is advisory only: these crops are flat material swatches, not isolated objects, so its foreground separation is weak by its own warnings. Albedo is the direct crop measurement.

evidence: WHITE on purpose with vertexColors: chrome #b9bcbf (region-chrome), engine alloy #6c6a66 (region-engine, 0.860), crankcase and swingarm #4a4742, seat vinyl #575759 (region-seat), tyres #4c4a46 and rims #a9a7a2 (region-tyre, 0.841), lamp #d8dde0, indicators #b87a3a, tail lamp #b03030.
Textureless as DECLARED: the parts are 6-40 mm; nothing resolves a texture at prop distance. No metalness: the harness has no environment map and chrome with nothing to reflect renders black.

buildPasses.goal: Match material color, roughness, bump, and local variation.
acceptance: Reference-derived albedo palette records dominant, secondary, and accent colors per visible material.
Each important material defines roughness variation and at least one normal/bump/displacement response.
Local material overrides, dirt/wear/stains/moss/chips/scratches or equivalent masks are tied to evidenceRefs.
Thin, transparent, reflective, wet, or fibrous materials document alpha/transmission/clearcoat/metalness/fiber response when relevant.
Generated preview uses procedural albedo/roughness/bump texture or vertex color variation instead of one flat color.
Generated preview uses independent PBR maps at 1024px or higher for the quality-first tier.
If source pixels are available, referencePbr extraction passed at confidence >= 0.7 or the pass is stopped/requesting better references.
Macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands are visible at the intended review distance without obvious tiling.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Add procedural surface locality such as normal/bump/displacement, AO, dirt, stains, chips, grain, moss, scratches, and wear.
acceptance: Every required material feature group has local overrides or surfaceDetail tied to evidenceRefs.
A grazing-angle close-up proves that normal/height detail breaks highlights naturally and does not read as smooth plastic.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Make material and form readable under neutral turntable lighting plus optional reference lighting.
acceptance: lightingFromPhoto identifies key light direction/color/intensity, fill light, rim or environment light, and ambient color.
Exposure, tone mapping, background color/gradient, shadow softness, and contact shadow behavior are specified.
Lighting does not hide geometry/material gaps and screenshots can be compared fairly to the reference.
Neutral, grazing, and reference-matched lighting checks distinguish material errors from lighting errors.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Make the model ready for future animation, transformation, physics, or destruction.
acceptance: Macro and movable meso components have stable pivot nodes.
Sockets, collider proxies, and destruction metadata are present for future runtime actions.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Protect runtime performance after visual fidelity is accepted.
acceptance: Triangle count, draw calls, instancing, LOD strategy, and FPS target are documented or verified.
Repeated detail is instanced or simplified where possible without breaking silhouette/material believability.

reviewHistory.summary: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.84. 2,776/4,000 triangles, 3/4 draw calls, 2/3 materials, 3/6 unique geometries, one 256 px canvas at 0.3 MB, factory 48 ms. Turntable: enclosed background is the step-through and fork daylight, allowed on measurement.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the large class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Two components and one repetition system: 3 of 4. Forty-odd fittings ride one merge.

materials.note: paint and a white vertex-coloured trim: 2 of 3. Chrome, alloy, vinyl, rubber and lamps differ in albedo only.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 2,776 of 4,000: the spoked wheel lathe is the cost (two instances of one geometry); the tubes are 8-segment cylinders.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Thin side-profile extrusions for the panels, polyline tubes for the frame and fittings, a spoked lathe for the wheel, boxes for the rest.
One InstancedMesh carries both wheels. No per-instance colour.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
Every material is declared textureless. One 256 px dust canvas is bound after construction on the paint. 0.3 MB of texture VRAM, factory 48 ms.

risks.description: The turntable gate flags the step-through and the daylight in the fork and under the seat.
risks.mitigation: Real open air on a motorcycle; --allow-holes on the _holecc measurement logged per azimuth.

risks.description: The right side is not in the plate.
